# Claude Window Starter

> Claude Window Starter is an open-source macOS app that automatically starts and schedules Claude Code's 5-hour usage window around working hours. It tracks real 5-hour and weekly usage limits, observes server-reported reset times, and schedules lightweight Claude Code requests so future resets land at more useful times.

Official repository: https://github.com/aetsr/claude-code-window-starter
License: Apache 2.0. Independent project; not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic.

## What it does NOT do

- Does not increase Claude Code quota
- Does not bypass or reset Anthropic usage limits
- Does not exploit authentication or API credentials
- Scheduled requests consume normal subscription usage

## Primary use case

Schedule a small legitimate Claude Code request (anchor) before work so a fresh 5-hour usage window may open and its reset aligns better with the workday. Adaptive replanning follows observed resets.

## Key details

- Platform: macOS 13+ (menu bar app)
- Backend: Python 3.10+ (stdlib only, no third-party dependencies)
- UI: SwiftUI menu bar app + launchd background helper
- License: Apache 2.0
- Installation: source build (no published binary yet)

## Installation

macOS 13+, Python 3.10+, Swift 6 build tools, signed-in Claude Code (`claude auth login`). No Anthropic API key. `git clone ... && ./scripts/install-macos.sh`. No published binary yet.

## Limitations

Does not increase quota, bypass limits, reset server timers, move active windows, run during sleep, or guarantee reset times. Anchors consume normal subscription usage. Server rules are Anthropic's.
